items.acceptance_test: land, space, industry, capital, talent, compute, data and scenario links have owners and return paths

items.requirement: 一带全球AI创新活动体系与长期运营设计
proposal_sections: 文化叙事、地标与长期运营

items.acceptance_test: annual cadence, ownership, maintenance budget band and rollback gate are explicit
